title: Expose scoped evidence applicability with attributable comparisons
statement: The Review and verification Module shall compare offered evidence with the exact claim basis and expose applicability mismatches, unknowns and accountable rationale without converting mechanical identity into semantic adequacy.

what.problem: Assurance preparation and retention can conflate planned methods, actual observations, semantic judgment and current reliance.
what.desired_outcome: Expose scoped evidence applicability with attributable comparisons.

why.rationale: SR-027 needs accountable assurance content and failure semantics in MOD-007.

conditions: An assessor prepares or reassesses assurance content for a declared engineering claim.

contexts: MOD-007 contribution to MOD-017 IF-014; guided recording through MOD-012 and existing IF-004/003.

how.approach: Apply assurance-content.md to exact supplied bases, preserve gaps and actual actor decisions, then confirm selected retention separately.

how_much.scope: All parent SR-027 criteria within the declared finite claim; operational persistence and execution authority retain their existing owners.

acceptance_criteria: Assess subject/state, criterion content, scope, conditions, provenance, evidence availability and governing freshness; retain concrete mismatches and unknown fields.
Require an attributable applicability rationale and inspected scope; a stable entity identity, method file or pass label alone cannot establish current applicability.
Keep requirement, Design, advisory, whole-change and Verify scope distinct; narrower advice cannot support broader approval merely through common files.
Distinguish an actor-reported no-change assertion from a defined mechanical comparison and preserve both scopes; neither timestamp nor saved status establishes unchanged content.
Expose incomplete evidence populations and uncertain dependencies, without assuming all contrary observations were discovered or all unchanged hashes imply adequate support.
constraints: Target Design; no implemented automation, executed verification or requirement satisfaction is asserted.

sources.basis: Derive assessor-assisted assurance preparation, explicit retention cooperation and scoped reliance through MOD-007 and IF-014. Preserve actual judgment, command and persistence ownership; target Design only.
